# Stable Diffusion reference pipeline

Imported from `xorbitsai/xinference-backend` commit `a979c575`,
`xinference/thirdparty/diffusers_community/stable_diffusion_reference.py`.
The implementation originates from Hugging Face Diffusers community examples:
<https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers/blob/main/examples/community/stable_diffusion_reference.py>.
See LICENSE.txt (Apache-2.0). Local import paths are preserved from the enterprise
snapshot; this package contains no model weights.
